cookies.name: Admiral Gimbap Cookie
cookies.description: Undefeated in battle, Admiral Gimbap Cookie's feat of winning a big sea battle without losing a single ship has become the stuff of legends. Even the infamously rough currents of the Laver Sea calm down in front of him. The spicy red seasoning that accompanies his otherwise restrained black and white attire is said to have been awarded to him in honor of keeping his fighting spirit even when the world turned its back on him. A truly remarkable hero, down to his quirky habit of keeping a diary!
cookies.skill: The small blue gauge charges over time. When it is full, Admiral Gimbap Cookie's troops launch various attacks to crush obstacles and create basic jellies, filling the green gauge a little. When the green gauge is full, Admiral Gimbap Cookie rides a giant turtle, firing torpedoes to crush obstacles and create Gimbap Jellies. (Leveling up increases Gimbap Jelly Points.)
cookies.combiBonus: Chronicles of Run Jelly Bonus, -12% HP drain

cookies.name: Adventurer Cookie
cookies.description: For a long time, there have been only rumors of Adventurer Cookie's travels far and wide beyond the realm of the Witch, but now he's back and ready to guide the other Cookies into uncharted territories of an exciting new world. Adventurer Cookie has got quite a lot of stories to tell: about a legendary dragon, a kingdom in ruins, but... So little time! His thirst for the unknown is unquenchable, and he will continue to roam the wide world as long as possible.
cookies.skill: Discovers secret doors to an underground passage filled with Coins and possibly a Mystery Box.
cookies.combiBonus: Backpacky +10% Coins

cookies.name: Alchemist Cookie
cookies.description: Made from the freshest of grapes, the fruit of the gods, this smart Cookie only cares about one thing: Research! She is always doing wild calculations, trying to figure out how to transform the elements. And she knows that being lazy or sitting idly by will achieve nothing. In order to acquire something of value, one must give something of value in return - that's Alchemist Cookie's theory at least.
cookies.skill: The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, a Double Jump launches an Alchemist Flask that spawns Jellies depending on the currently selected type. Each jump landing toggles between the different types of alchemy. (Leveling up causes the gauge to fill up faster.)
cookies.combiBonus: Jelly Scale +20% XP , Coin Scale +20% XP

cookies.name: Angel Cookie
cookies.description: Angel Cookie is trying to master the art of flying but can't rise higher than a teeny tiny bit above the ground just yet! Angel Cookie's favorite animals are penguins, ostriches, and baby chicks. Can you guess why? Shiny golden curls are the source of the Cookie's special Magnetic Aura, which attracts all Coins and Jellies nearby. Yum!
cookies.skill: Draws in Items with magnetic aura
cookies.combiBonus: Wishing Star +40 HP after Pet Revive

cookies.name: Apple Cookie
cookies.description: A Cookie that resembles a crisp, refreshing spring morning! This cute little Cookie loves apple-shaped balloons and alphabet bubbles. No other Cookie can rival her powerful yet innocent creativity and brilliant imagination. She even created her own Bonus Time to play to her heart's content. Like any other youngster Cookie, she runs like there's no tomorrow at first. But after all that energetic running, little by little, she slows down when tiring out.
cookies.skill: The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, Apple Cookie creates Alphabet Jelly Bubbles. (Some of the Bubbles are empty.) Enters a special Bonus Time where Balloon Jellies appear. Runs faster at first, but slows down when losing HP. (Leveling up makes Alphabet Jelly Bubbles appear more frequently.)
cookies.combiBonus: Apple Rabbit Balloon Jelly Bonus

cookies.name: Banana Cookie
cookies.description: Banana Cookie's fabulous hula hoop show begins! She used be a world-famous wilderness explorer, becoming friends with all sorts of animals and critters. With so many fresh bananas from the tallest of trees in her dough, it's no wonder that Banana Cookie is an expert climber. While climbing a massive tree, she met Choco the Monkey. The two immediately knew they were best friends for life! The duo decided to join the circus and, ever since, their show has energized crowds to the max! Banana Cookie is always so full of energy that it seems she never gets tired from performing! Perhaps she's enjoying her own shows a bit too much. Even after the curtains close, she's still spinning her hula hoop. Some say she's too excited because of all the Coins that were thrown on stage. But in reality, she's just excited and happy all the time!
cookies.skill: The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, Banana Cookie leaves the stage to Choco the Monkey. The more hoops the monkey jumps through, the more Coins are dropped to the ground at the end of his performance.
cookies.combiBonus: Banana Lion +10% Coins , Jelly Scale Coin Bonus , Chronicles of Run Pet collects Coins instead of points

cookies.name: Barley Sentry Cookie
cookies.description: Barley Sentry Cookie usually flutters around like a baby sparrow, but at crucial times, he seizes the moment to transform into a fierce warrior, defeating enemies with his sturdy Barley Spear in hand. He looks quite dignified and serious as he keeps on the lookout for bugs hiding in the fields.
cookies.skill: Gains Magnetic Aura and points for all Jellies while shielded. Grows larger and faster with each gathered Barley Jelly. Catching a Barley Jelly fills the green gauge a little. When it is full, Barley Sentry Cookie assumes his sentry form, triggering Blast while creating Jellies and crushing obstacles. Partially restores HP at the end of the transformation.
cookies.combiBonus: Pegaplush Barley Jelly Bonus, Giant: -HP drain

cookies.name: Blackberry Cookie
cookies.description: Blackberry Cookie always wears a reserved look, but it would be hard to find a more caring and devoted Cookie. She has been working at one prestigious household for a long time, and is praised for her miraculous ability to do a multitude of tasks in virtually no time! Despite Blackberry's tightest schedule, she always finds the time to save the life of her venturesome employer. Perhaps, this is her main duty these days.
cookies.skill: Spirits surrounding her eat Jellies and periodically create Blackberry Jellies. (Leveling up increases the number of Blackberry Jellies.)
cookies.combiBonus: Ghost Butler Blackberry Jelly Bonus

cookies.name: Blooming Dancheong Cookie
cookies.description: Blooming Dancheong Cookie was baked from gat-kimchi, made by grinding plum blossoms that bloomed in the snow and seasoning them over mustard leaves. Born from ingredients that overcame biting winds and solitude, this Cookie came to possess a spirit both resilient and noble. To create a land where Cookies could thrive, Blooming Dancheong Cookie gathered the energy of the Five Colors, swept away the heavy clouds, and planted a colossal plum World Tree on Mount Kimchi, the peak closest to the sky, linking heaven and earth as one. Warm sunlight and the gentle fragrance of plum blossoms soon began to fill the barren land. A world that had once been silent slowly became alive with the laughter of Cookies, and Blooming Dancheong Cookie, accompanied by the Plum Blossom Dragons, continued to watch over them. Though the tale now lives on only as legend, a lone shrine is said to still be standing at the summit of Mount Kimchi, where Blooming Dancheong Cookie is worshipped as a mountain spirit.
cookies.skill: The small blue gauge charges over time. When it is full, Plum Blossom Jellies grow, charging the green gauge a little. When the green gauge is full, Plum Blossom Dragons fly by, turning basic Jellies into Plum Blossom Jellies and Coins.
cookies.unlockedBy: Special acquisition (event / no unlock condition in data)

cookies.name: Braised Pork Cookie
cookies.description: No one tops Braised Pork Cookie when it comes to plowing the field! Braised Pork Cookie's limbs are strong from working the fields. So famous she became for her reliability in handling all the village's tasks that Pine Monk Cookie recruited her into his traveling party. Her biggest strengths are her fiery temperament that causes her to charge straight into any problem, and her hearty nature that allows her to shake off any hardship and bounce right back at the sight of a delicious meal.
cookies.skill: The small blue gauge charges over time. When it is full, Braised Pork Cookie tills the soil to harvest Braised Pork Jellies. Each harvest fills the green gauge a little. When the green gauge is full, the Cookie whirls around the Braised Pork Pitchfork to draw in Jellies and obstacles. Jellies absorbed thusly award bonus points. Finally, Braised Pork Cookie throws the pitchfork to draw in Jellies in front. (Skill activates faster the lower the remaining HP.)
cookies.combiBonus: Bok Choy Cushion
cookies.unlockedBy: Have Kaymak / Pine Monk / Lotus Root Cookie

cookies.name: Buttercream Choco Cookie
cookies.description: They don't call him "Rich" without reason - Buttercream Choco Cookie knows how to handle his Coins, with positive return on all investments. He wouldn't share his secret, but a source tells us he is particularly into renewable energy.
cookies.skill: More Coins (up to 25%)
cookies.combiBonus: Dust Unicorn -20% Pet cooldown

cookies.name: Candied Yam Cookie
cookies.description:
Candied Yam Cookie came into being by adding Lotus Honey to sweet potatoes placed as offerings of devotion by Cookies. Using appropriate trials to prevent them from fixating solely on comfort and sweetness, she guides Cookies towards attaining enlightenment by their own strength. Recently, she has bestowed a major task upon Pine Monk Cookie and his disciples, and is paying particularly close attention to their journey toward enlightenment.
Since time immemorial, she has always listened to the Cookies' prayers and extended a helping hand, ensuring that no Cookie has to succumb to despair at the end of a lonely life. Maybe she is even right now quietly listening to our small voices!
cookies.skill: The small blue gauge charges over time. When it is full, Candied Yams falls from the sky and create Candied Yam Jellies. Each activation fills the green gauge a little. When the green gauge is full, Candied Yam Cookie enters an enlightened state and creates Sacred Bear Jellies that are drawn towards her by the power of enlightenment.

cookies.name: Carol Cookie
cookies.description: This gentle Cookie believes that a song can be stronger than a sword. She exerts great power with just a song of beautiful poetry and melody. "No matter what happens, I will always have my songs. If you need more strength, I'll sing of how beautiful life can be. If obstacles bother you, I'll sing the magic Song of Change. If Coins are what you need, let me sing of abundance."
cookies.skill: Switches songs every 7 multi jumps: Song of Life recovers HP, Song of Change turns obstacles into Jellies, Song of Abundance creates Coins. Leveling up increases frequency of song effects.
cookies.combiBonus: Yule Log Cake -15% HP drain

cookies.name: Cheerleader Cookie
cookies.description: Fresh lemon juice and mints were used to bake Cheerleader Cookie. Her sunny and cheerful personality energizes Cookie crowds better than anything else. Rumor has it that she takes energy drink showers to refresh her dough and soul. Now that's refreshing!
cookies.skill: A cheerleader squad comes to help after every 32 jumps, crushing obstacles and spreading Coins and Jellies. Leveling up reduces the number of jumps needed and increases the time for the squad.
cookies.combiBonus: Glitter Ball -15% HP drain

cookies.name: Cheesecake Cookie
cookies.description: This flavorful Cookie is made out of an entire cheesecake. Since she has never known a life without Coins, she likes to throw luxurious parties and set off Coin Fireworks for her friends. She's always stylish, using only the finest cheese, as she casually trots along. It's hard to resist the temptation to devour this deliciously decadent Cookie.
cookies.skill: Gathering 18 Invitation Jellies triggers a Coin Fireworks Party.
cookies.combiBonus: Fluffy Cheese Cat +10% base speed, +12% Coins , Golden Drop Mini Magnet, +15% Coins , Chronicles of Run Pet collects Coins instead of points

cookies.name: Cherry Blossom Cookie
cookies.description: On a warm spring day, the first pink cherry blossoms were collected and then infused for a generous amount of time. Then this essence was used to create Cherry Blossom Cookie. Just by looking at her, you will feel splendid and warm inside, with a tingle on both your cheeks. On a perfect day, you can see her humming, trying to fly into the air with her umbrella open. She is most adorable when she offers you delicious sandwiches and tea. But watch out, once she starts to chat, you will lose track of time!
cookies.skill: The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, Cherry Blossom Cookie takes flight, creating Cherry Blossom Jellies along the way. Creates Cherry Blossom Jelly Party in Bonus Time. (Leveling up makes the gauge fill faster.)
cookies.combiBonus: Tea Cup Cherry Blossom Jelly Bonus

cookies.name: Cherry Cookie
cookies.description: Behind her endearing smile and adorable looks, Cherry Cookie hides a destructive nature. A true troublemaker decorated in bright red cherry syrup, she enjoys pulling destructive pranks. She especially enjoys throwing her Cherry Bombs, which blow up like fireworks. Surprisingly, the smoke from her exploded bombs smells sweet and can relieve one of all the stress in the world.
cookies.skill: Throws Cherry Bombs that crush obstacles and create Cherry Jellies. Speeds up over time, but hitting an obstacle sets her back to normal speed. Leveling up grants more frequent bombs.
cookies.combiBonus: Rocket Firecracker Cherry Jelly Bonus , Spotlight Fan Cherry Jelly Bonus

cookies.name: Choco Pistachio Cookie
cookies.description: Boing! Choco Pistachio Cookie travels across the Cocoa Desert in search of the Pistachio Oasis. After discovering rich Spread Springs within the oasis, the Cookie built a massive fortune from collecting the precious liquid. The confident pose may come off as a little arrogant at first glance, but in truth, this Cookie generously shares the hard-earned spring water with every Cookie across the Cocoa Desert—a true believer in giving back to the community.
cookies.skill: Periodically summons a Spiky Choco Mole that carries the Cookie forward. Movement Speed increases while riding. Landing from a Double Jump while mounted uncovers Spread Oil and creates Choco Pistachio Jellies. Counts as a riding skill.
cookies.combiBonus: Choco Hedgehog Riding: -HP drain, Jelly Bonus

cookies.name: Cinnamon Cookie
cookies.description: Sweet cinnamon powder lightly scatters each time this Cookie swings his cape. If you happen to be at Cinnamon Cookie's show, prepare for some of the most hectic, yet amazingly spectacular card tricks! As they go up and down and side to side, it is almost impossible to follow. One might say that Cinnamon Cookie's limitless energy can be tiresome, but as long as a single Cookie enjoys the wonderful show, it must go on. Keep your distance though: being too close to this sweet-scented magician will make you sneeze. Poof!
cookies.skill: The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, Cinnamon Cookie performs various card tricks. Dazzles with Revival Magic when running out of HP once. (Leveling up makes the gauge fill faster.)
cookies.combiBonus: Cinnamon Bunny Cinnamon Card Jelly Bonus

cookies.description: "I dance cuz life's a party and we each make our own funky beat," she likes to say. Her dream is to dance in the clouds. Cloud Cookie's energetic persona makes Power Jellies last longer.
cookies.skill: Increases Power Jelly duration (up to 35%).
cookies.combiBonus: Rainbow's End Start in Bonus Time

cookies.name: Cocoa Cookie
cookies.description: Even though her dough is already 80% cocoa, she's always sipping hot cocoa, even during summertime. Her marshmallow hat is so deliciously sweet that she needs to resist the temptation of taking a chunk out of it and dipping it into her cup. Her plump, smooth cheeks just add to her charm! When she indulges in a freshly prepared cup of cocoa, all her worries melt away.
cookies.skill: Gathering HP Potions summons a flying Cocoa Mug to ride in. While flying, regular Jellies turn into Cocoa Marshmallow Jellies awarding more points. Recovers more HP from Potions. (Leveling up increases flight duration and recovery amount. The Cocoa Mug counts as a riding skill.)

cookies.name: Coffee Cookie
cookies.description: A classic city slicker Cookie, Coffee Cookie refuses to start the day without a cup of coffee. She loves meeting up with friends, shopping for designer bags, and pilates. Infused with strong coffee, she recovers faster with each Energy Potion.
cookies.skill: Increases HP recovery from potions (up to 29%).
cookies.combiBonus: Mocha Delight -30% Pet cooldown

cookies.name: Cotton Candy Cookie
cookies.description: Cotton Candy Cookie is made from the sweetest of sugars and undoubtedly has the highest level of sugar among the Cookies. With such a saccharine heart, no wonder she's always in love! Cotton Candy Cookie spends all her days writing love letters but ends up throwing away more than she sends. Her goal is not to reveal her feelings to her beloved one but to cherish each moment of being in love. Cookies often joke that Cotton Candy Cookie sends way too many letters, but the truth is that everyone secretly wishes for one: what's inside the envelope is so very sweet!
cookies.skill: Collects a unique set of Alphabet Jellies that lead to a special Bonus Time. Touching Mail Boxes in Bonus Time creates Heart Letters. Occasionally throws away unfinished love letters that burst destroying obstacles and creating Cotton Candy Jellies. (While running, Alphabet Jellies may sometimes appear in place of basic Jellies.)

cookies.description: A delicious mix of cookie and cream, she enjoys knitting in front of a warm oven. Years of running taught her to manage the scarce HP pool well, so even though she prefers knitting in the warmth of the Oven, once she gets running, she doesn't tire easily.
cookies.skill: Slows HP drain (up to 17%).

cookies.name: Cream Puff Cookie
cookies.description: Sweet Cream Puff Cookie makes you feel good just by looking at her. Made of soft and delicate cream puff, this Cookie is as fragile as can be. Something about her makes you worry about her, but that's her charm point. Although she is a bit clumsy, great powers lie within her, and her potential is unpredictable. After many failed attempts with her spells, she often visits the old library to cheer herself up. Will Cream Puff Cookie be able to become a respected wizard? Let's find out!
cookies.skill: The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, Cream Puff Cookie casts a Minor Jelly Spell to create a small amount of Jellies. Sometimes this triggers a Jelly Storm, generating a large amount of Jellies. (Leveling up makes the gauge fill faster.)

Slower HP drain while sitting on the lotus leaf.

cookies.name: Dandelion Fairy Cookie
cookies.description:
Dandelion Fairy Cookie is a gentle friend to nameless wildflowers. No matter how barren the land, it is quickly colored with a warm energy of happiness upon encountering Dandelion Fairy Cookie's flower breeze.
Dandelion Cookie rides the wind on her Pom-pom Flower Stalk diligently every day to bring a happy and cozy spring to all Cookies and fill the world with love and gratitude.

cookies.name: Devil Cookie
cookies.description: Devil Cookie is mysterious in many ways. This Cookie might look hot and spicy but tastes like fizzy cola. According to a trustworthy source, they are made of bat extract and a few drops of carbonated beverage. Devil Cookie's ultrasonic powers allow them to see flying Spectral Jellies invisible to the others. Catching those Jellies unleashes the feared Super Devil.
cookies.skill: Transforms into an all-consuming Super Devil after collecting Spirit Jellies. By leveling up, fewer Spirit Jellies are required to trigger the transformation.
cookies.combiBonus: Flame Bat Spirit Jelly Bonus

cookies.name: Dino-Sour Cookie
cookies.description: Highly enriched sour jellies were melted as ingredients for this sour Cookie. The most important rule in baking Dino-Sour Cookie was styling a sharp hairdo with sour cream mousse. Because he craves extreme adventures and loves dinosaurs, he practically lives in the Dragon's Valley. On one of those adventures, he met his companion. He accidentally dropped a fossil, but to his surprise, a Jellysaur popped out! Now, these two have become the best of pals and set out on dangerous adventures together.

Landing from the air while riding the Jellysaur creates Dino Paw Jellies on the ground. Landing from greater heights creates more Jellies. (Jellysaur Ride counts as a riding skill.)
cookies.combiBonus: Dino Egg Dino Paw Jelly Bonus, -13% HP drain

cookies.description: With the least calories and highest fiber content, she is the healthiest Cookie of all. She can even produce oxygen, which keeps the air clean around her. She uses the energy of the forest to create a protective shield. Those who envy Fairy Cookie say she has strawberry jam of ambition inside, but you don't believe them, right?
cookies.skill: Creates magnetic aura which also serves as a shield
cookies.combiBonus: Flower Pod +15% XP

cookies.description: Garaetteok Cookie's fierce gaze is fixed on the village shrine under the protection of the heavens. After wandering the land in search of learning, he was chosen by the shrine as the village's guardian. With a nature as pure and firm as garaetteok, he watches over the village day and night, the totems his only companions.

cookies.name: General Jujube Cookie
cookies.description: This long-bearded Cookie is from the furthest eastern edge of the continent. Don't let his fierce appearance intimidate you; he is actually quite sweet. And he becomes even sweeter when his face reddens with anger or surprise! With his Candy Glaive, he can deflect oncoming arrows with swift slashes and destroy everything standing in his path with one fell swoop. But, don't worry, behind his rough exterior is a delicate soul: just look at all the care he puts into combing out his beard.
cookies.skill: The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, General Jujube Cookie rides his Red Jujube Horse, crushing obstacles as arrows fly towards him. While Riding, a Candy Scimitar button replaces the Slide button, which crushes obstacles and creates Jujube Slice Jellies. (Horseback Riding counts as a riding skill. Leveling up makes the gauge fill faster.)
cookies.combiBonus: Uncooling Teacup More Arrows, Jujube Jelly Bonus

cookies.name: Ginger Claus
cookies.description: It's the Cookie you can meet after being a good child for the whole year. It is said that this Cookie was baked in a faraway land and crawled into the oven through the Witch's chimney. Ginger Claus loves giving presents more than receiving them and goes around handing out special, but pretty odd gifts for everyone.
cookies.skill: +13% Coins, +3% XP
cookies.combiBonus: Merry Hat -35% Pet cooldown , Holiday Stocking +10% base speed

cookies.description: GingerBrave was the first Cookie to escape from the Witch's oven. It is unknown how this Cookie came to life, but rumor has it that the Witch accidentally used magic powder instead of ginger powder. Level up for more HP.
cookies.skill: Not just a running Cookie. He can Jump, Double Jump, and Slide, too!
cookies.combiBonus: Choco Drop +5 HP

cookies.name: GingerBright
cookies.description: Maybe the Witch thought GingerBrave seemed lonely all by himself, because she baked GingerBright with the leftover dough from making GingerBrave.  Sweet and bubbly GingerBright is full of life. But this smart Cookie clearly knows that it would be a bad idea to offer her lollipop to GingerBrave! She's so smart, she even found a way to get extra XP every time.

cookies.name: Gulab Jamun Cookie
cookies.description: Little Gulab Jamun Cookie fell in love with dance at her very first Holi, many years ago. Now, there is no other dancer as graceful as she is. Her movements are as vibrant and fluid as honeyed syrup, yet delicate, leaving behind a faint but captivating trail of cardamom and rose. It is said that just watching Gulab Jamun Cookie perform can free your heart of all worries.
cookies.skill: The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, Gulab Jamun Cookie starts a festival, dancing to the music, setting off color splashes, and creating Gulab Jamun Jellies and Coins. The more Gulab Jamun Jellies are collected, the greater the color splash. (Leveling up increases Gulab Jamun Jelly Points.)

cookies.name: Gumball Cookie
cookies.description: The hard outside and soft inside of a gumball were separated, then evenly mixed into the batter and--ta-da!--Gumball Cookie was born! If you smell a sweet and sour aroma, Gumball Cookie is nearby! He is out on a mission to transform the boring world into a fun and colorful playground with his gumball cannon! Walls? Ceilings? Obstacles? Everything is a canvas for this mischievous cookie! It is said that he angered the Witch by coloring her oven the day after he was born. For his turbulent nature, he is resented sometimes, but he will stop at nothing to share his art with the world.
cookies.skill: Loads gumballs while jumping and shoots while sliding. The shots crush obstacles and earn shot points. Consecutive shots increase shot points. Up to 20 gumballs can be loaded at a time. (Leveling up increases the amount of shot points earned.)
cookies.combiBonus: Mini Jackson No.2 -15% HP drain

cookies.description: Warm like the sunshine and fresh like the scent of rain, Herb Cookie will ease your mind when you're feeling down. Made of fresh green herbs, this Cookie may not be to everyone's taste. On rainy days, Herb Cookie loves to listen to the sound of falling raindrops under his trusty leaf umbrella. On warm days, he enjoys the sunshine together with his favorite plant. This Cookie treats all living things and every moment as precious. He believes that the little things that make you laugh or cry are to be cherished, just like a ray of sunshine after the rain.
cookies.skill: A water gauge appears above Herb Cookie's head. Rain and Sun Jellies appear periodically. Picking up Rain Jellies causes rain, filling up the water gauge. When the gauge is full, picking up a Sun Jelly brings out the sun to turn regular Jellies into Sprout Jellies. Slower HP drain. (Leveling up makes Rain and Sun Jellies appear more frequently.)
cookies.combiBonus: Herb Teapot Sprout Jelly Bonus

cookies.name: Hero Cookie
cookies.description: While the other Cookies escaped the hot oven one by one, this Cookie remained inside, lost in his research. He was brilliant enough to finally succeed in building an ultimate escaping machine, the Caramel Syrup Suit. The suit is optimized for escape with a rechargeable Candy Engine as its core source of energy. Now, the only task left is to continue his studies to reduce Candy Engine's recharge time.
cookies.skill: The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, Hero Cookie puts on his Caramel Syrup Suit for a flying Blast with magnetic effect and slower HP drain.
cookies.combiBonus: Jellyco Cube Jelly Bonus (Transform Bonus)

cookies.name: Kaymak Cookie
cookies.description:
Hard as granite and swift as the wind, Kaymak Cookie knows not a fear in the world. He is known for his arrogant nature, fearing not even the heavens, but upon closer inspection, he possesses a nature as pure and profound as milk.
After spending 500 years isolated in the mountains due to his uncontrollable power, he was able to return to the world and embark on a path of asceticism under the guidance of a certain Cookie. Through indefatigable training, he has learned to wield his power beneficially and is being reformed into a Cookie with an increasingly deep and solid flavor.
cookies.skill: Swings his Golden Honey Staff to crush obstacles during Blast. The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, Kaymak Cookie rides on his Milk Cloud, summoning decoys that crush obstacles and create Kaymak Jellies.
cookies.combiBonus: Honey Gourd Crush Points, -12% HP drain

He feels most alive going uphill at top speed with the wind blowing directly in his face. But, no worries, "Safety first" is his motto. Kiwi Cookie has vowed to fill the world with his kiwi scent, and it seems like nothing will quench his thirst for adventure.
cookies.skill: The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, Kiwi Cookie blasts ahead on his bike. Picking up Kiwi Fuel Jellies boosts bike speed for a short time and prolongs the duration of the ride. (Leveling up makes the gauge fill faster.)

cookies.description: A fox-shaped marshmallow wished to become a Cookie so much it mastered a spell to shapeshift into a Cookie by subsisting only on flour and butter for 999 days. As a result, she can now disguise herself as a seductive and attractive Cookie. Anyone who catches even a glimpse of her will instantly fall in love. Perhaps she's dazzling them with her nine tails.

cookies.name: Lemon Cookie
cookies.description: Lemon Cookie was born not inside the hot Oven, but in a cold, neon-lit laboratory during an experiment with electricity. A giant, highly acidic lemon was used in the making of this Cookie, hence he courses with electricity. The cube that Lemon Cookie always carries with him controls the electric currents in his body. In his childhood, Lemon Cookie had only one friend who was always fascinated with his cube tricks. When Lemon Cookie couldn't control his power and became a danger to other Cookies, this friend was the only one to be there for him... Always listening to his music, Lemon Cookie might not be easy to approach, but who knows what electrifying surprises might await us if we do?

The shield's magnetic field attracts all Jellies, including Dark Moon Jellies. During Blast, Lemon Cookie crushes obstacles around him. (Leveling up makes the gauge fill faster.)

cookies.description:
Lotus Root Phantom Cookie used to spend the time leisurely by a small lake in the desert. She would put her trickster mind to use by playing all kinds of pranks on unassuming Cookies that had gotten lost in the desert.
When Pine Monk Cookie's party managed to avoid falling for her traps, she took a keen interest and joined them on their journey.
Though she rarely reveals her true feelings, she seems quite content among this group of unique and talented personalities.

cookies.name: Moon Rabbit Cookie
cookies.description: Fresh rice harvested from the happy soils of the Cookie World was used for baking cheerful Moon Rabbit Cookie. This Cookie's chubby cheeks are always filled with sweet rice cakes. While some may think it's cute, her craving for more rice cakes may be one of the strongest forces of the Universe. That craving can even become so strong that she might turn into a giant Rice Cake Bunny, and—oh boy!—you'd better keep your distance because she is going to wreak SWEET HAVOC. Ever since, the Cookies have kept a tradition of holding hands and going around in circles under the full moon.

Whenever she feels sad, she falls asleep, where she is able to lean on her friend Moon and draw in the night sky with her Star friends to cheer up.

This Cookie likes to spend time at the shore, staring dreamily at the horizon, or playing the shell ocarina. An old friend, the Peppermint Whale, often appears to the sound for company. Peppermint Cookie treasures the simple but unchanging things, just like the waves that come and go. May the Cookie's smile remain unchanging as well!

While riding the whale, the Jump and Slide buttons call dolphins to gather Jellies instead. (The Peppermint Whale counts as a riding skill. Leveling up makes the gauge fill faster.)

Pine Monk Cookie was born beneath a Red Pine Tree that endured the river's fierce currents and strong winds. While his often unrestrained and inconsiderate behavior makes it hard to believe he is a monk, no one can deny his competence in effortlessly solving any problem with his brilliant mind and eyes of wisdom.

Possessing immense magical power, monsters coveting his strength are constantly eyeing Pine Monk Cookie, but with his trusty companions by his side, he seemingly has no need to worry.

However, no matter how hard she tries to fulfill her mission, she spends a lot of time all by her lonesome self. If only she were better at aiming...

cookies.name: Pistachio Cookie
cookies.description: A purple storm cloud loomed over the forgotten pistachio forest where Pistachio Cookie was sleeping. With a sudden strike of lilac lightning, she received a divine revelation that it was her destiny to rescue the Cookies. When she awoke, she was surrounded by hundreds of Pistachio Fireflies with hard pistachio shells. She realized right then and there that now was her time to shine! She then swore to the divine and mysterious being that she would give her life to helping other Cookies. Clad in her shell armor, the healthy and deliciously nutty Pistachio Cookie then set out on her sacred mission to save her fellow Cookies from the great dangers that approached the Cookie World. Thus, Pistachio Cookie took her first step as a holy knight.

Sikhye Cookie spends more time lingering in front of a candy store choosing treats than contemplating her next move!
As soon as she sits down in front of a Baduk board, her eyes gleam as she plans dozens of moves ahead in an instant. With her free-spirited nature, she constantly throws moves as unpredictable as the grains of rice in Sikhye at her opponent.

cookies.name: Skater Cookie
cookies.description: The secret to Skater Cookie's speed and boarding skills lies in the special elasticity of his Cat Tail Candy Cane Board. Inseparable from his 2009 limited edition board, he even sleeps on it too! Not everyone can handle Skater Cookie's speed, but if you dare, prepare for a sweet ride. Warning: Once you get a taste of Skater Cookie's speed, other Cookies may feel a bit slow.
cookies.skill: Faster base speed (up to 35%)
cookies.combiBonus: Lucky Dice Bros +20% base speed

cookies.name: Skating Queen Cookie
cookies.description: It is true that only top quality ingredients were used to bake this Cookie, but that never stopped her from giving her best at exhausting rehearsals. Her unparalleled discipline and practice are what gave the finishing touch to the Cookie we know today. Her graceful performances never fail to receive extra points. Other Cookies simply pale in comparison.
cookies.skill: Earns Performance Points for Double Jumps, Blast Jellies, and Bonus Time.
cookies.combiBonus: Snow Blossom -10% HP drain

cookies.name: Snow Sugar Cookie
cookies.description: Made of snow, sugar, and an unknown secret ingredient, this Cookie was once very lonely, wandering through a vast snow field. One day, Snow Sugar Cookie found a magic wand that could summon snow creatures and wouldn't melt even in the oven. The Cookie quickly learned to summon friends like the Snow Cone and the Great Snow King and was never lonely again.
cookies.skill: Summons Snow Cones that destroy obstacles and create Snow Blossom Jellies when the small blue gauge is full. Gathering Snow Blossom Jellies fills the green gauge. Once it is full, the Great Snow King appears and causes a snowstorm. Riding the Great Snow King restores a small amount of HP. (Great Snow King counts as a riding skill.)

cookies.name: Soda Cookie
cookies.description: This Cookie was baked once, then baked once again under the sun of the beach. He was glazed with a special oil, then toasted to the perfect shade of golden brown. He is now a free-spirited waterproof Cookie who loves to surf on the popsicle surfboard he found in the Witch's freezer. He has the power to generate cool soda waves wherever he wishes. Watching this Cookie smoothly coast along, you'll feel like it's summertime all the time. Oh yeah!
cookies.skill: Gathering HP Potions triggers cool Soda Waves. Blast Mode is triggered while riding the waves on his surfboard, obstacles are swept away by the waves, and collecting Jellies awards bonus points. (Leveling up increases the duration of the waves.)
cookies.combiBonus: Lemon Slice Lemon Slice Bubble Jelly Bonus

cookies.description: Armed with a sweet candy gun, Special Force Cookie passed special force training with flying colors and joined the Cookie Intelligence Agency shortly after. Her mission is classified, but likely involves escaping from the oven first.

cookies.name: Strawberry Shortcake Cookie
cookies.description: Once a Cake Hound deeply loved by their Cookie, they eventually went to doggy heaven. After making a wish to the Witch, they returned as half-Cookie, half-hound. While they can't quite remember their Cookie's face anymore, the joyful memories they shared remain vivid. Perhaps a familiar sniff will help them recognize the Cookie again!
cookies.skill: Periodically creates Dog Chew Jellies that trigger Blast on all fours. Each Dog Chew Jelly fills the green gauge a little. When it is full, Strawberry Shortcake Cookie rides a Giant Cake Hound and turns nearby Jellies into Cake Slice Jellies. (Giant Cake Hound counts as a riding skill.)

cookies.name: Sujeonggwa Cookie
cookies.description: With a subtle scent of cinnamon and a focus as firm as ginger, Sujeonggwa Cookie always sits before the Baduk board with a look of perfect calm. With each move built upon sincerity, she always delivers quiet yet profound moves, much like the subtle sweetness lingering at the end of a bitter flavor.
cookies.skill: The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, Sujeonggwa Cookie builds a house out of Baduk Stone Jellies. Winning the gambit by collecting most of the Sealed Black Stone Jellies creates a Black Masterful Gambit Stone. Throwing this stone crushes obstacles, earns Crush Points, and triggers coin fireworks.

cookies.name: Tiger Lily Cookie
cookies.description: It is not known how Tiger Lily Cookie ended up in the jungle all by herself. Under the constant threat of encroaching enemies, her senses grew sharp. In contrast to her rough outward appearance, she is soft and delicate on the inside. Her only family is her trusty Butter Tiger, whom she cherishes more than anything in the world. Her great skill with the spear and excellent jumping abilities make her one tough Cookie to beat.
cookies.skill: The small blue gauge charges over time. When it is full, Tiger Lily Cookie throws her spear, turning obstacles into grass. Jellies or HP Potions grow where the spear hits the ground. Throws the spear again immediately when picking it up from the ground. Each spear throw fills the green gauge a bit. Summons the Butter Tiger for a fast ride when the green gauge is full. (Butter Tiger counts as a riding skill.)
cookies.combiBonus: Furball Pup Tiger Lily Cookie Crush Bonus
cookies.unlockedBy: Special acquisition (event / no unlock condition in data)

cookies.name: Vampire Cookie
cookies.description: The Witch, busy from baking several Cookies at once, had forgotten to use her favorite high quality grapes. So, she stored them in oak barrels and let them age for a long, long time. And with that special grape juice, she made Vampire Cookie. It was difficult for Vampire Cookie to wake up at first, due to the 10% of strong grape juice in the dough. Unlike the other Cookies, he does nothing but relax and enjoy life. He wasn't even bothered by the heat of the oven and only escaped because his sister, Alchemist Cookie, dragged him outside. With his pale face and smug posture, he likes to relax with a nice glass of grape juice and ponder the meaning of life.
cookies.skill: Transforms into a swift Grape Bat when the green bar is full. As a bat, Vampire Cookie can pass through obstacles, earning Evasion Points, but must keep flapping his wings to stay above the ground. Occasionally extracts Grape Juice Drops from obstacles to restore HP, but HP drain is faster. (Leveling up makes the gauge fill faster.)
cookies.combiBonus: Oak Barrel Evasion Bonus

cookies.name: Werewolf Cookie
cookies.description: While adding great amount of pepper into the cookie dough, a wolf hair had fallen in by accident. Hence, whenever Werewolf Cookie feels scared or threatened, his wolf instinct kicks in and he transforms into a feral beast. A long time ago, his friend fell in grave danger, and Werewolf Cookie saved him only after transforming and revealing his true self to the townsfolk. He was castaway out of fear and has been living alone in the forests since. With so much pain buried within him, this Cookie tastes bitter and salty (of tears). Don't ask about his scar or try to get close to him. He'll only push you away cause he's afraid he'll hurt you. We can only assume he's been hurt deep inside, just like his deep scar under his eyes.
cookies.skill: The green gauge charges over time (the lower the HP, the faster). When it is full, Werewolf Cookie changes into wolf form to crush obstacles, earning Crush Points. Careful: Werewolf Cookie can still fall into pits while in wolf form. (Leveling up makes the gauge fill faster and increases the amount of Crush Points.)
cookies.combiBonus: Furball Pup Crush Bonus as Wolf

cookies.name: White Choco Cookie
cookies.description: A Cookie made of indulgent gourmet white chocolate. White Choco Cookie's moves are both elegant and precise. With her fencing sword, she is sharp and graceful. Without it, she remains delicate and precise. Watch her perfect hair shine with every step she takes. White Choco Cookie can always be found surrounded by her devoted Cookie fans. With her excellent skill and dapper appearance, it's no wonder she makes the hearts of her female fans bubble with adoration.
cookies.skill: Sliding charges two gauges. Standing up when the small gauge is full crushes nearby obstacles. Standing up when the big gauge is full triggers Blast Mode for a short distance. At the end of Blast Mode, obstacles in a large area are crushed. All obstacles crushed by White Choco Cookie's skill turn into White Choco Jelly. The small gauge fills faster at higher running speed.

cookies.name: Wind Archer Cookie
cookies.description: Originally, this Cookie was the wind who loved the green of the forest. This wind delightfully spent its days spreading fresh and sweet fragrances across the forest. In order to save the paradise in peril, a mysterious being granted it the power to purify the Darkness. This transformed the wind into Wind Archer Cookie, the protector of the forest. As long as Wind Archer Cookie's heart keeps hope, he'll carry on his duty.

They can be easily acquired at the local cemetery and come without an expiration date, so they can be stored basically forever. Zombie cookie can revive easily and is really only worried about falling into pits.
cookies.skill: Revives after running out of HP (up to 8 times with 17 HP)

pets.skill: Periodically drops Sotdae poles from the sky to create Almond Slice Jellies. Obstacles hit by the poles become transparent and passable.
pets.combiBonus: Garaetteok Cookie

pets.name: Spotlight Fan
pets.description: Brings out the best in every Cookie. When it shines over you, a wonderful vanilla scent is spread around too. If that's too much attention for you, just take a step back.
pets.skill: Periodically shines a spotlight over the Cookie that grants Magnet, crushes obstacles on collision, and slows HP drain. (The Magnet does not stack with other magnetic effects.)
pets.combiBonus: Rockstar Cookie Music Jelly Bonus , Cherry Cookie Cherry Jelly Bonus , Kaju Katli Cookie +20% HP drain

pets.name: Sweet Rice Seal
pets.description: This little fellow likes to sit still and think …and think …and think. It thinks that because it thinks that it exists. When it thinks too much, it rolls over on its back and stops for a while to let some thoughts go.
pets.skill: Rolls around and earns points after collecting a certain number of Jellies.
pets.combiBonus: Red Bean Cookie Fish Treat Jelly Bonus

pets.name: Tater Trader
pets.description: A cheerful little Tater Trader helping Potato Salad Cookie run the shop in exchange for delicious homemade salads. It's surprisingly excellent at managing Coins and keeping business booming, though its sales strategy mostly consists of yelling "Buy everything!" at every customer who walks by.
pets.skill: Periodically creates a Giant Jelly surrounded by Coins. Grants bonus Coins depending on speed.

pets.description: The first thing Cherry Blossom Cookie does at a picnic is to drink tea from her lovely tea cup. No matter what the weather, it maintains the perfect temperature and blend! With this kind of tea cup, you will want to go on a picnic every single day!

pets.name: Tiny Tabla

pets.name: Uncooling Teacup
pets.description: This pet is a very special gift received by General Jujube Cookie. One well-known story claims that before his tea cools, General Jujube Cookie can quickly destroy every obstacle that lies in his path. But, shhh... the secret to this trick is that this pet is self-heating.

pets.description: Originally raised as the third son of the Dragon King, he was turned into a dragon horse as punishment for a transgression. Pine Monk Cookie took pity on it bouncing around on its curled tail and gave it pine needle wings. Every once in a while, the seal is broken and it regains its original dragon form for a little while, but quickly reverts to its cuter self.
